description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ballapana, Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 61008
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and property characteristics) in the Ballapanaudabage area. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
